mcu_g_0160_2000206a.name: upgrade_hdr_id16_b1_rx
mcu_g_0160_2000206a.description: Byte 1 of the 16-byte received header array at 0x20002069. mcu_0160_0800672c compares that array byte by byte with the flash bytes at 0x08001400 when DAT_200006C8 equals 0x400, and a mismatch sets error code 7. The rest of the array is a separate heading in data_unreferenced_batch24. This entry covers only this byte, so delete it if batch24 documents 0x20002069 as one 16-byte object. Meaning not confirmed.

mcu_g_152_20002079.name: upgrade_hdr_tail2_152
mcu_g_152_20002079.description: Two bytes read in build 152 by mcu_0160_0800672c through a base register. No decompiled line names them, so they are probably part of the received upgrade header block of that build. Not confirmed; the second byte is heading 0x2000207A.

mcu_g_0160_20002099.name: upgrade_hdr_id6_rx
mcu_g_0160_20002099.description: Six received header bytes, probably identification values. mcu_0160_0800672c compares them one by one with the flash bytes at 0x08001430 when DAT_200006C8 equals 0x400, and a mismatch sets error code 11. Only the first six bytes are compared, so the bytes after them are not part of this object. The expected values stay in flash and are not copied here.

mcu_g_0160_200020a9.name: upgrade_hdr_id16_0160_rx
mcu_g_0160_200020a9.description: Sixteen received header bytes, probably identification values, present in build 0160 only. mcu_0160_0800672c compares them one by one with the flash bytes at 0x08001440 when DAT_200006C8 equals 0x400, and a mismatch sets error code 12. This object covers headings 0x200020A9 and 0x200020AA. The expected values stay in flash and are not copied here.

mcu_g_12b_20002778.name: cfg_record_copy_12b
mcu_g_12b_20002778.description: 32-byte record copied word by word (eight u32 words) from the argument of mcu_12b_0800bfd0 into RAM. The copy runs only when DAT_200006E0 is zero, which it sets to 1. The record is probably a parameter block from a received message; the words are not decoded. Present in build 12b only.
